label: Bible Study
prompt: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy _____, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
verse: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
note: Abram's call — leave the country, the relatives, and the family home, for a land not yet named.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the _____.
verse: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
note: Blessed in the city, blessed in the field — downtown or out on the farm, the blessing covers both.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among _____, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
verse: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
note: The Good Samaritan story begins on the Jericho road, with a man who fell among thieves and was left half dead.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Having a _____ of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verse: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
note: A last-days portrait: the look of religion with the engine removed — 'from such turn away.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the _____ of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
verse: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
note: Before Christ, Gentiles were 'aliens from the commonwealth of Israel' — outsiders now 'made nigh' (verse 13).
